description: This Python source file defines a class 'GeminiPassthroughLoggingHandler' with static methods for handling and logging passthrough responses related to Gemini models, including special handling for long-running predictions and content generation. It is part of an LLM proxy server dealing with video creation and content generation via Gemini models.
